root_idea.summary: The root expresses leveling, evenness, and equality of placement, whether in a flat tract of land or in things standing side by side in a row.
root_idea.development: The reduplicated form صفصف is associated with level ground; the same orientation extends to forming ranks and placing things evenly.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested adjective صفصف is a distinct lexical item and is displayed under its normalized citation form.

senses.definition: Level, smooth, and even; a level plain or expanse.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description of the land in 20:106, it characterizes the ground as level and smooth.
A reported interpretation of the Quranic land description emphasizes that the surface is stripped or bald and without vegetation; this is a distinct descriptive nuance of the same construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set, place, or station people, a military force, or things in a rank, row, or line.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intensive form صَفَّفَ is reported with an intensive sense. Collective and reflexive derivatives can mean to gather themselves together or stand in ranks, including gathering at a watering place; اصطفّوا means to stand or become arranged in ranks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel: to set the forelegs evenly side by side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized use is reported in the context of milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel: to yield or be milked into a row of bowls by combining two or three milking vessels at one milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression refers to the abundance of the camel’s milk and to the vessels being placed together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut meat into broad or thin strips or slices, and lay it on coals or in the sun for roasting or drying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported descriptions include cutting the meat thin enough to be translucent and placing it on live coals or in sunlight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird: to extend or expand its wings in a line without flapping them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use describes gliding or holding the wings extended in flight, in contrast with active wing-beating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a ṣuffa, or saddle covering, on a horse or other riding animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a figurative or specialized use connected with the saddle accessory called صُفَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To face an opponent in a rank or draw oneself out in a rank against the opponent in battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes opposing parties forming lines for combat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose house porch or covered frontage faces another person’s porch.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes two house appendages standing opposite or facing one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To travel or become alone in a level tract of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is reported in connection with being alone in a صفصف, or level expanse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pasture on trees called صفصاف.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a separately reported verbal use associated with the willow-like tree name صفصاف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cry or chirping sound of a sparrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is reported as an infinitive or simple substantive and is associated with dialectal use of صُفْصُف for sparrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rank, row, or line; an even front or forepart of things; or a company standing in such formation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can be used collectively or as a singular with a collective sense. It also occurs in Quranic expressions involving ranks, but the relevant QAC form group here is the separate adjective صفصف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A station or place where people stand in ranks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In a reported Quranic usage, صفًّا is also explained either as a prayer or festival gathering-place or as a circumstantial expression meaning people standing in ranks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pair of bowls placed together, especially as filled at one milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is attributed to the vessels being put side by side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A medicament used to whiten the teeth.
A roofed appendage, porch, portico, or covered frontage of a house or building.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression أهل الصفة referred to poor refugees and other houseless people lodged in the covered area adjoining the Prophet’s mosque. The expression عذاب يوم الصفة is reported with a disputed identification, sometimes equated with عذاب يوم الظلة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A saddle accessory or covering fitted between the front and rear parts of a horse or camel saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can refer to the component enclosing or supporting the saddle’s structural pieces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long period of time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is reported as a figurative use in the expression صُفَّةٌ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quantity of grain that can be held in the palm of the hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is reported as an assumed figurative use in a traditional expression about possessing no food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment worn beneath a coat of mail during battle.
A she-camel characterized by producing a row of bowls of milk, filling vessels set side by side, or setting her forelegs evenly while being milked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The descriptions differ in whether the name emphasizes the camel’s abundant milk, the paired vessels, or the even position of her forelegs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Meat cut into strips, broad slices, or oblong pieces and roasted, dried, or partly cooked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported preparations include roasting on coals or pebbles, drying in the sun, and making broad slices unlike ordinary قديد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Ṣūfiyya, a designation associated with the people of the ṣuffa.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained in relation to أهل الصفة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Standing or placed in a row or rank; applied to camels arranged in a row for slaughter and to angels standing in ranks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural صَوَافّ is used of camels in a reported Quranic expression, while الصافات describes angels standing in ranks in another Quranic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird: expanding its wings and not flapping them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This participial use corresponds to the bird’s extended-wing flight described under the verb صَفَّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert or waterless tract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form صَفْصَفَة is also reported in this sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ridge, brow, or ledge of a mountain.
A sparrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This designation is reported in one or more dialects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dish or mess of the food called سكباجة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is also reported in the dialect of Thaqīf.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small insect, identified as a weevil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is described as foreign or adventitious to Arabic and is associated with a Persian designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A willow-like tree, identified with خِلاف in the lexical sources.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: صَفْصَافَة is reported as its nomen unitatis; species identifications vary by region and dialect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A station or place where ranks are drawn up in war or battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is مَصَافّ.
